events.title: HF News Twitter
events.description: The Writ3rs HF News team has launched a Twitter account (@HFWrit3rs) to deliver news as early as possible. Multiple team members have access and sign tweets with initials (HY = iHydra, FG = Froggy, SM = Soulmate). The account will tweet user news, bans, changes, and drama.

events.title: deVoid Theme and Tabs Go Live
events.description: After criticism over the previous retro-inspired purple theme, Omniscient created a gray scale theme called deVoid for Hack Forums and brought tabs navigation back. Many elements aren't yet final and constructive criticism is welcome.

events.title: Avatar Gallery Installed
events.description: Omniscient announced that the gallery of avatars is now available to all members. Remote avatars aren't allowed at this time, and removing avatars has been disabled — upgraded users are urged to upload images.

events.title: Let the man Work
events.description: Omniscient asked the community to give his inbox a break over the upgrade situation and let him work on improvements rather than reply to dozens of repetitive PMs. He also publicly shot down many of the most common suggestions he has been receiving.

events.title: Group leadership changes.
events.description: Lukas is now a leader of Influence. ScreemS is no longer a leader of Influence.

events.title: Posts, prestige, and reputation milestones
events.description: GoldenEra has reached 1,000 posts; #Programmer has reached 500 prestige; Froggy has reached 500 prestige
